title: Give no-SQL pull requests the migration-readiness context at once, draft or ready

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-13: migration-readiness stalls PRs on Expected and takes too long.

detail: The trusted gate (migration-readiness.yml) is a pull_request_target job with a Supabase token and refuses drafts on purpose, so every draft PR sat on Expected, and every Update branch waited on that job again. migration-readiness-fallback.yml is an unprivileged pull_request job, modelled on db-tests-fallback: it lists the PR's own files and posts a success commit status named migration-readiness only when none is under supabase/migrations/. A PR that adds SQL gets nothing from it, so the trusted gate keeps its full protection and no probe, test or gate script was edited.
